description: The dataset is explicitly named for a poster studying how carbon nanotubes affect metal-organic frameworks used to remove bromodichloromethane from an aqueous environment. It supplies source data about a specified disinfection-byproduct treatment material, with a separately deposited related poster. The inspected title identifies the contaminant and material combination; it does not establish the tested concentrations, component ratios, sorption mechanism or quantitative removal response. The source authors provide these water-quality study data; geographic coverage is not stated. The source marks the data restricted while publishing CC BY 4.0 metadata. No access procedure, fee, availability date or permission to obtain the underlying files is established. Only descriptive metadata and file descriptors were inspected. Data values, archives, images and linked article or poster bodies remain unread. The reported treatment subject establishes the resource role, while measurement quality, independent sample counts and overlap with related experiments remain unverified.
